mapper.select: SELECT gt.*, a.area_name AS area_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, u.user_name AS manager_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.name) AS equipments_name_str FROM garbage_transfer gt LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON gt.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON gt.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON gt.manager_id = u.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_equipment e ON FIND_IN_SET(e.sys_equipment_id, gt.equipment_ids) AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE gt.deleted = 0 GROUP BY gt.id, a.area_name, os.name, u.user_name ORDER BY gt.id DESC

SELECT gt.*, a.area_name AS area_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, u.user_name AS manager_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.name) AS equipments_name_str FROM garbage_transfer gt LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON gt.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON gt.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON gt.manager_id = u.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_equipment e ON FIND_IN_SET(e.sys_equipment_id, gt.equipment_ids) AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE gt.deleted = 0 GROUP BY gt.id, a.area_name, os.name, u.user_name ORDER BY gt.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}
